_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Generate a chat message
operations.description: Generate the next chat message in a conversation between a user and an assistant.

messages.description: Chat history as an array of message objects (each with a role and content)

tools.description: Optional list of function tools the model may call during the chat

format.description: Format to return a response in. Can be `json` or a JSON schema

options.description: Runtime options that control text generation

think.description: Controls a model's thinking output. Use `/api/show` to discover the supported values and default for the selected model. `true` requests thinking, `false` requests no thinking output, and `null` uses the model default. String values are model-defined; supported names must match `/api/show` exactly. Numbers are not supported.

keep_alive.description: Model keep-alive duration (for example `5m` or `0` to unload immediately)

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each token position when logprobs are enabled

source.description: Existing model name to copy from

model.description: Name for the model to create

template.description: Prompt template to use for the model

renderer.description: Name of the renderer for the model

parser.description: Name of the parser for the model

files.description: Source file names mapped to their SHA-256 digests. Split GGUF models must include each shard under its original split filename.

draft_files.description: Draft source file names mapped to their SHA-256 digests

license.description: License string or list of licenses for the model

system.description: System prompt to embed in the model

messages.description: Message history to use for the model

quantize.description: Quantization level to apply during import (e.g. `nvfp4`)

draft_quantize.description: Quantization level to apply to draft weights during import

requires.description: Minimum Ollama version required by the model

capabilities.description: Capabilities to add without removing inherited or inferred capabilities (e.g. `decision` for compatible decision models)

operations.name: Generate embeddings
operations.description: Creates vector embeddings representing the input text

input.description: Text or array of texts to generate embeddings for

truncate.description: If true, truncate inputs that exceed the context window. If false, returns an error.

dimensions.description: Number of dimensions to generate embeddings for

options.description: Runtime options that control text generation

operations.name: Generate a response
operations.description: Generates a response for the provided prompt

prompt.description: Text for the model to generate a response from

suffix.description: Used for fill-in-the-middle models, text that appears after the user prompt and before the model response

format.description: Structured output format for the model to generate a response from. Supports either the string `"json"` or a JSON schema object.

system.description: System prompt for the model to generate a response from

stream.description: When true, returns a stream of partial responses

think.description: Controls a model's thinking output. Use `/api/show` to discover the supported values and default for the selected model. `true` requests thinking, `false` requests no thinking output, and `null` uses the model default. String values are model-defined; supported names must match `/api/show` exactly. Numbers are not supported.

raw.description: When true, returns the raw response from the model without any prompt templating

keep_alive.description: Model keep-alive duration (for example `5m` or `0` to unload immediately)

options.description: Runtime options that control text generation

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each token position when logprobs are enabled

operations.name: List models
operations.description: Fetch a list of models and their details

operations.name: List running models
operations.description: Retrieve a list of models that are currently running

model.description: Name of the model to download
Name of the model to publish

verbose.description: If true, includes large verbose fields in the response.

operations.name: Answer typed questions
operations.description: Answer choice, yes/no, and scoring questions with a System One model, locally or in Ollama's cloud. Requires Ollama v0.35.0 or later, or v0.40.5 or later for cloud models. See the [decision guide](/capabilities/decision) for examples.

model.description: Model trained for System One, such as nimble, or clef:cloud for Ollama's cloud.

state.description: A nonempty string, or an object or array serialized as JSON text. Not interpreted as chat messages or multimodal input.

images.description: Base64-encoded images shared by all questions, in request order. Requires a model with vision, such as Clef. Models with audio input also accept WAV clips here. URLs and data URLs are not supported.

questions.description: Named questions about the shared state. Answers are not passed to later questions. Cloud models accept names of up to 100 ASCII letters, digits, `_`, `.`, or `-`.

keep_alive.description: How long to keep the model loaded after the request, as a duration string (such as 5m) or seconds. Zero unloads after the request; a negative value keeps it loaded. Defaults to the server's keep-alive setting (5m unless configured otherwise).

operations.name: Cloud usage
operations.description: Usage statistics for cloud inference, web search, and web fetch.

range.description: Completed UTC hours or days to include, plus the current partial hour or day.

scope.description: Your requests, or your team's requests. Team scope requires being a team admin.

group_by.description: How to group usage within totals and buckets. Supported values: model.

operations.name: Get version
operations.description: Retrieve the version of the Ollama
